claim: Jun-2026 figures corroborated independently of the parse
detail: Reports standalone PAT Rs 14,804 cr (+16% YoY, from Rs 12,768 cr), NII Rs 24,385 cr (from Rs 21,635 cr), GNPA 1.38%, NNPA 0.35% for Q1 FY27; NIM 4.36%. The year-ago base figures (PAT Rs 12,768 cr, NII Rs 21,635 cr) also match the panel's Jun-2025 row exactly.
source: NDTV Profit -- 'ICICI Bank Q1 Results: Profit, NII, Margins Beat Street Estimates; Asset Quality Improves'

claim: Disclosed provision coverage, and the buffers held outside that ratio
detail: The bank's disclosed provision coverage ratio on non-performing loans was 74.7% at 30 Jun 2026 (pipeline check below compares it with the panel's ratio-implied coverage). The filing also shows what sits OUTSIDE that ratio: contingency provisions of Rs 13,100 cr plus an additional standard-asset provision of Rs 1,283 cr (created Q3 FY26 as directed by the RBI for the agricultural priority-sector portfolio); total provisions of Rs 22,963 cr outside specific provisions, ~1.4% of the loan book. Gross NPA additions were Rs 5,552 cr in the quarter, write-offs Rs 1,673 cr, and provisions (ex-tax) fell to Rs 1,260 cr from Rs 1,815 cr a year earlier.
source: Business Today -- 'ICICI Bank Q1 results: Net profit rises 15.9% to Rs 14,805 crore; asset quality stays stable'

claim: Absolute net NPA stock essentially flat YoY; capital position
detail: Net NPA stock Rs 5,908.27 cr at Jun-2026 against Rs 5,971.09 cr a year earlier -- the net bad-loan stock is essentially flat year-on-year even as the gross ratio fell from 1.67% to 1.38%. Total capital adequacy 16.84%; advances Rs 16,31,260 cr (+19.6% YoY); deposits Rs 18,33,586 cr (+14% YoY).
source: Financial Express -- 'ICICI Bank Q1FY27 results: Net profit up 16%, net NPAs stable'
